2026-10-10 11:39:39.028462 | controller | Possible reasons for having these kinds of units are:
2026-10-10 11:39:39.028465 | controller | • A unit may be statically enabled by being symlinked from another unit's
2026-10-10 11:39:39.028469 | controller |   .wants/, .requires/, or .upholds/ directory.
2026-10-10 11:39:39.028472 | controller | • A unit's purpose may be to act as a helper for some other unit which has
2026-10-10 11:39:39.028475 | controller |   a requirement dependency on it.
2026-10-10 11:39:39.028478 | controller | • A unit may be started when needed via activation (socket, path, timer,
2026-10-10 11:39:39.028481 | controller |   D-Bus, udev, scripted systemctl call, ...).
